greeting.text: Ho there, traveller! Puck's the name. Every wood and stone and old wall in the Lea, Puck knows. Lost, are you?

puck.text: Puck is me and I am Puck, though some calls us brownies, hobgoblins and robins. We are the jesters of the Faerian court, and the bard calls us shrewd knaves.

puck-rock.text: Puck rock is not a genre, it's a rock where the [[puck]] like to hang out.

faerie.text:
It's three days travel, wading through rivers of blood and tears. 

Some say that there are four island cities there, each with its own prophet poet.

choices.label: Can you show me the way into Faerie?

faerie-way.text: I can show it, but you wouldn't see it. It's nothing personal, most of you who dwell in this green world are blind.

see.text: Do I look like a doctor?

choices.label: Are there any doctors around, then?

doctors.text: What, just because I don't LOOK like a doctor means I can't be one? No but really, I can't be one. Not legally, since the incident. You know, I was the best frond transplant surgeon in the Lea but now they won't even let me near a fern.

badger.text: There's the badger by {badger}, but he's not accepting new patients.

choices.label: Are there any HUMAN doctors around?

human-doctors.text: To be perfectly honest, I highly doubt that a human could make it through medical school. But to be even more honest, I don't really talk to humans, present company generously excluded. So go and ask one of them.
